notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.aboutP1: Clousight monitors cloud service health and alerts you when issues occur.
notifications.aboutLi1: Info: General service updates and recovery notices
notifications.aboutLi2: Warning: Service degradations that may affect performance
notifications.aboutLi3: Critical: Major outages that require immediate attention
notifications.aboutSeverityNote: The list uses three display levels: Info, Warning (includes major/minor/maintenance severities from providers), and Critical.
notifications.aboutSettings: You can configure notification preferences in the {settings} page.

notificationCenter.title: Notifications
notificationCenter.emptyFiltered: No notifications match the current filters. Try “All” or adjust filters above.

subscriptions.title: Subscription rules
subscriptions.lead: Match public status events by provider, region, and severity. Server-side delivery uses email and webhooks when configured.
subscriptions.selectProvider: Select at least one provider, or enable “Match all providers”.
subscriptions.ruleLimitHint: You have reached the maximum of {max} rules for this account.
subscriptions.emptyHint: No subscription rules yet. Create one to get notified about incidents you care about.
subscriptions.cascadeHint: Exact for AWS, best-effort for Alibaba. Incidents without a region or service tag will not match a filter.

settings.title: Settings
settings.checkHelp: How frequently to check for service status updates
settings.cloudProvidersDesc: Select which cloud providers to monitor
settings.saveFailed: Failed to save settings. Please try again.
settings.localeHelp: Match browser: any Chinese UI language uses Simplified Chinese (zh-CN); English otherwise. V1 supports English and Simplified Chinese only.
settings.themeHelp: Choose how Clousight appears. System follows your browser or operating system.
settings.officialDataNote: Status data comes from providers’ official public sources.
settings.notifyRulesHint: Choose which incidents notify you in your subscription rules:
settings.privacyNote: No account, no server — all settings stay in your browser.
settings.aiHelp: Bring your own OpenAI-compatible API key to generate short incident briefings. Your key is stored locally and only sent to the endpoint you configure.
settings.aiKeyLocalNote: Stored locally in this browser only — never synced.
